transcript: Speaker A: अबे 10 मिनट से खड़ी हूँ, चाय नहीं बन पाई तेरी [Hey, I've been standing here for 10 minutes, your tea isn't ready yet?] Speaker B: Sorry for the delay Ma'am. It will be ready in couple of minutes. Speaker A: अरे भाई, तुम तो अलग इंग्लिश बोल रहे हो, ये कहाँ से सीखी? [Ma'am, it's the era of English. Now look at yourself, I spoke in English so you also spoke in this manner. That's why learning English has become necessary for everyone. That's why I downloaded the PW Talk app. PW Talk app has English learning videos just like Reels. When I get time, instead of wasting time on Reels, I watch this. And then to practice, there is also an AI English teacher named Reeba. She talks to you in English, corrects your mistakes. And she is AI, right, so there's no fear of making mistakes in front of her. I've been using this app for a few weeks, and my English is definitely getting better.] Speaker A: वाह भाई बहुत बढ़िया, क्या नाम बताया ऐप का? [Wow brother, very nice, what did you say the app's name was?] Speaker B: पीडब्ल्यू टॉक [PW Talk] Voiceover: English speaking सीखना है तो PW Talk app अभी download करो। [If you want to learn English speaking, download the PW Talk app now.]

summary: A customer is surprised when a local tea seller speaks fluent English. He explains that he uses the PW Talk app to learn English through reel-like videos and practices with an AI teacher named Reeba. The ad encourages viewers to download the app on Google Play.
